what.title: What is ALS? Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis explained
what.description: ALS is a disease of the motor neurons that carry movement from brain to muscle. Who gets it, how often, the ways it starts and spreads, and its forms.

neurons.title: Upper vs lower motor neuron signs in ALS, animated
neurons.description: ALS damages both upper and lower motor neurons. See what each loss does: spasticity and brisk reflexes, or weakness, wasting and fasciculations, and EMG.

tdp43.title: TDP-43 in ALS: how the protein goes wrong, animated
tdp43.description: In most ALS, the protein TDP-43 leaves the nucleus and clumps. Watch it happen, and see what is lost, from STMN2 splicing to axon repair. SOD1 and FUS too.

genes.title: ALS genetics: C9orf72, SOD1, FUS and genetic testing
genes.description: Is ALS inherited? The C9orf72 repeat, SOD1 and other genes, penetrance by age, the familial share, and what the 2023 US testing guideline says.

dx.title: ALS diagnosis: Gold Coast and El Escorial criteria calculator
dx.description: No single test diagnoses ALS. Try the Gold Coast, revised El Escorial and Awaji criteria on example findings, and see how EMG, MRI and NfL fit in.

ddx.title: ALS mimics: the differential diagnosis
ddx.description: Conditions that can look like ALS, from multifocal motor neuropathy to Kennedy disease and cervical myelopathy, and the signs and tests that tell them apart.

course.title: ALSFRS-R score and ALS progression rate calculator
course.description: Score the 12 ALSFRS-R items, work out the progression rate, and see how ALS usually changes over months, with King's stages and the ENCALS model.

drugs.title: ALS drugs: riluzole, edaravone and Relyvrio
drugs.description: What riluzole and edaravone target, what their trials found, and why Relyvrio (AMX0035) was withdrawn. Labels, effect sizes and approvals since 1995.

tofersen.title: Tofersen (Qalsody) for SOD1-ALS, explained
tofersen.description: Tofersen is an antisense drug that lowers SOD1. How it works, what the VALOR trial and its extension showed, who it is for, and its side effects.

breathing.title: Breathing in ALS: FVC, SNIP and when NIV is offered
breathing.description: How ALS weakens breathing, the tests used to follow it, and the published triggers for non-invasive ventilation (BiPAP), side by side across guidelines.

nutrition.title: ALS swallowing and feeding tubes: when PEG is discussed
nutrition.description: Why weight matters in ALS, how swallowing changes, and when guidelines discuss a gastrostomy (PEG, RIG), with the ProGas results and diet trials.

living.title: Living with ALS: communication, cognition and end of life
living.description: Voice banking, eye-gaze and brain-computer interfaces, thinking and behaviour changes, mood, planning ahead, caregiving and what is known about end of life.

nursing.title: ALS nursing care: assessment, medicines and teaching
nursing.description: Nursing care in ALS as published: breathing and swallowing assessment, giving riluzole and tofersen, NIV and gastrostomy teaching, and documentation.

cure.title: Is there a cure for ALS? Research routes and evidence
cure.description: No treatment cures ALS yet. Gene silencing, antisense drugs, cell therapy and platform trials, each with its evidence label and current trial status.

history.title: History of ALS: Charcot to tofersen
history.description: ALS was named by Charcot in the 1870s. Lou Gehrig, the first genes, TDP-43, the Ice Bucket Challenge and the first drugs, milestone by milestone.

review.title: ALS flashcards and mnemonics
review.description: Flashcards and mnemonics on amyotrophic lateral sclerosis by topic: the disease, diagnosis and course, treatment and care, living with ALS, history.

quiz.title: ALS quiz, with explanations
quiz.description: Test yourself on ALS: motor neurons, TDP-43 and genes, criteria, ALSFRS-R, drugs and tofersen, breathing and nutrition. Every answer is explained.

glossary.title: ALS glossary: terms explained
glossary.description: Plain definitions of the terms in ALS care and research, from fasciculation and TDP-43 to FVC, NIV and antisense. Searchable, each linked to its module.

sources.title: Sources and references | ALS Companion
sources.description: Every reference behind ALS Companion: journal articles, guidelines, drug labels, regulatory documents and trial registrations, searchable by topic.
